Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub:  Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Audio Recording of Conference Call  
 
 
Further to our communication dated 06.05.2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI 
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, this is 
to inform that a Conference Call to discuss results of Quarter 4, Financial Year 2025-26 of 
the Company was organised on today i.e. Monday, 11th May 2026 at 1600 Hours (IST). 
The audio recording of the said conference call has been uploaded to the Company’s 
website which can be accessed through the link given below: 
 
Link: https://www.shipindia.com/upload/investorsubpage/audio.mp3 
 
The transcript of the said conference call will be submitted in due course.  
 
The above is for your information and record please. 
 
Thanking You. 
                                    
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
    Yours faithfully, 
For The Shipping Corporation of India Limited 
 
 
 
                                                                                       Smt. Swapnita Vikas Yadav 
                                                                    Company Secretary and Compliance Officer 
 
SWAPNITA 
VIKAS 
YADAV
